title: Formula for Veronese fraction generators
statement: For a scheme X, an invertible module L, a natural number d, a homogeneous section s of degree d, and an additive equivalence e between the corresponding homogeneous localization and section-fraction presentation, if e equals the choice of the core equivalence, then for every n and ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d), e applied to HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk ... n ξ.val ξ.property equals the displayed sectionFraction with numerator transported by exponent commutativity, tensorPowMulIso, and the inverse left unitor.

source.place: Equation module-invert-s (Tag 0B5L), Lemma 01PW(2), and the Veronese localization in the proof of Lemma 01Q1

proof.text: The construction follows by identifying homogeneous summands with tensor-power section summands and quotienting by transition relations.

theorem sectionRing_veronese_fraction_formula
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d)
    (e : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≃+
      SectionFractionPresentation (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d))
    (he : e = Classical.choice (sectionRing_veronese_fraction_core X L d s)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
      e (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
        ξ.val ξ.property) =
      sectionFraction (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d) n
        ((eqToIso (congrArg L.tensorPow (by simp [Nat.mul_comm])) ≪≫
          L.tensorPowMulIso d n ≪≫ (λ_ _).symm).hom.app ⊤ (ξ.val (n • d)))
